reports.title: La-Z-Boy Incorporated Reports Solid Second Quarter Results; Strong Sales Growth In Both Retail And Core North America La-Z-Boy Wholesale Businesses

guidance.heading: Third Quarter Outlook
section: Taylor Luebke, SVP and Chief Financial Officer of La-Z-Boy Incorporated, said, “We expect fiscal third quarter sales to be in the range of $505-525 million and adjusted operating margin(2) in the range of 4.0-5.5%, reflecting a measured view of the macroeconomic backdrop, uneven consumer demand, and our continued near-term strategic investments and transitional costs as we optimize our plant footprint and progress our distribution and home delivery transformation.”

desk.headline: Sales up 1% to $526m, beat; adjusted EPS $0.53 beat; Q3 sales outlook $505-525m
results: Sales rose 1% to $526m, or 4% excluding the wholesale casegoods business sold in May.
Company-owned stores grew delivered sales 14% to $252m on new and acquired stores; same-store written sales dipped slightly after a soft October.
Adjusted operating margin fell to 5.0% from 7.1% on supply-chain investment, plant consolidation and a one-off warranty benefit in last year's quarter.
Cash was $247m with no external debt; $32m went to buybacks and dividends, and the dividend was raised 12% to $0.27.

guidance.summary: For Q3 La-Z-Boy expects sales of $505-525m and an adjusted operating margin of 4.0-5.5%, citing uneven consumer demand and ongoing transition costs.

watch: Same-store written sales after a weak October and better early Q3 trends.
Margin recovery as plant consolidation and the delivery overhaul are completed.
